slices.title: Show the dormant badge through the plugin's same-origin relay

automated: verify: with the daemon stopped, load the fixture app; the "intervu: no agent" badge shows, clicking it shows the `intervu <url>` command, and the console has no errors.
verify: send a `/__intervu/*` request with a foreign `Origin`; it is rejected.
verify: the existing artifact-mode E2E specs still pass unchanged.
manual: A pixel check of the dormant badge on one of Daniel's real Vite apps.

slices.title: Keep intervu out of production builds

automated: verify: run `vite build` on the fixture app; the output contains no intervu code and no `data-intervu-src`.

slices.title: Run the plugin on the previous Vite major

automated: verify: serve the fixture app on the current Vite major and on the one before it; the dormant badge shows and the console has no errors on both.

slices.title: Open an origin-keyed Session from a URL
slices.seam: a helper that runs the CLI

automated: verify: run `intervu <fixture-url>`; the stdout TOON names the Session and the next `poll`, and no new tab opened.
verify: run `intervu <fixture-url> --open`; a browser tab is opened.
verify: run `intervu <fixture-url>` from a second route; the same Session key comes back.
verify: the existing artifact-mode E2E specs still pass unchanged.

slices.title: Report an unreachable app and a missing plugin
slices.seam: a helper that runs the CLI

automated: verify: run `intervu <url>` against a port nothing listens on; it exits 1 with an `AppUnreachable` TOON error and no Session is created.
verify: run `intervu <url>` against the fixture app served without the plugin; the Session opens and the output carries the missing-plugin help line.

slices.title: Address the origin's Session from poll, reply, end and the Home list
slices.seam: a helper that runs the CLI

automated: verify: after `intervu <fixture-url>`, bare `intervu` lists the URL-mode Session beside an open artifact Session.
verify: `poll <fixture-url>`, `reply <fixture-url> "<msg>"` and `end <fixture-url>` act on the origin's Session and print the same TOON shapes as for a file.

slices.title: Replace the badge with the floating panel when a Session opens

automated: verify: run `intervu <fixture-url>`; within 2 seconds the overlay replaces the badge in the already-open tab without a page reload.
verify: drag and collapse the panel; it moves and collapses, and the app's viewport width does not change.
verify: a fixture element with a very high `z-index` stays below the panel.
manual: A pixel check of the floating panel on one of Daniel's real Vite apps.

slices.title: Annotate the live app with its JSX source

automated: verify: with annotate-mode off, clicking a fixture button runs its handler; with annotate-mode armed, the click creates an annotation and the handler does not run.
verify: arm annotate-mode, click a fixture element, send; `poll <fixture-url>` returns that Feedback with `source` matching the element's JSX `file:line:col` and the current `pageUrl`.
verify: click inside a fixture `node_modules` component; the annotation's `source` is the nearest app-code element.
manual: Daniel runs it on one of his real Vite apps, and the agent edits the right file on the first try for at least 8 of 10 annotations.

slices.title: Keep selectors, snapshots and routes clean

automated: verify: annotate a fixture element and send; `poll <fixture-url>` returns a selector without `data-intervu-src` and a snapshot without overlay markup.
verify: annotate on two fixture routes and send; both annotations land in the same Session, each with its own `pageUrl`.

slices.title: Sync the Conversation live across tabs

automated: verify: `reply <fixture-url> "<msg>"` shows the message in the panel of two open tabs.
verify: a message sent from one tab appears in the other tab's panel live.
verify: Presence shows while `poll <fixture-url>` waits, and `end <fixture-url>` shows the ended state in the panel.

slices.title: Survive HMR and full page reloads

automated: verify: edit a fixture source file while an annotation is pending; HMR shows the change, and the Conversation, the pending annotation and the panel position are still there.
verify: reload the page with an unsent draft and a moved panel; the draft and the position are still there.

slices.title: Document URL mode in the Skill
slices.seam: a helper that runs the CLI

automated: verify: run `intervu setup` into a throwaway directory; the written Skill explains opening a URL-mode Session, adding `intervu()` to `vite.config.ts`, and what `source` and `pageUrl` mean.
